response.sql: WITH team_averages AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM team_averages) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, t.avg_wins - m.mean_avg_wins AS wins_above_mean FROM team_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE t.avg_wins > m.mean_avg_wins ORDER BY wins_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
